en: It's the clock Dad sent from Petalburg. Its hands are still at twelve.
text: E ceasul trimis de tata din Petalburg. Limbile încă arată ora douăsprezece.

en: {player} set the clock to the right time.
text: {player} a potrivit ceasul la ora exactă.

en: {player}, how's your room? Oh, you've set the clock! It looks lovely up there.
text: {player}, cum e camera? O, ai potrivit ceasul! Ce frumos arată totul acolo sus.

en: Come back downstairs for a minute, would you? I've got something to tell you.
text: Coboară un minut, te rog. Am să-ți spun ceva.

en: The clock ticks away quietly. It keeps good time.
